definitions.gloss: wallet case; wallet pouch; wallet holder
definitions.explanation: A protective case or pouch designed to hold a wallet, or a bag pocket specifically meant for storing one's wallet.

examples.japanese: {革|かわ}の{財布入|さいふい}れを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a leather wallet case.

examples.japanese: このバッグには{財布入|さいふい}れのポケットがある。
examples.english: This bag has a wallet pocket.

examples.japanese: {旅行中|りょこうちゅう}は{財布入|さいふい}れに{入|い}れて{首|くび}から{下|さ}げておくとスリに{遭|あ}いにくい。
examples.english: When traveling, keeping your wallet in a case hung around your neck makes it harder for pickpockets to get it.

notes:
Composed of {財布|さいふ} (wallet) + {入|い}れ (container, holder). Follows the common Japanese pattern of noun + {入|い}れ to mean a container for that item (e.g., {名刺|めいし}{入|い}れ — business card case, {小銭|こぜに}{入|い}れ — coin purse, ペン{入|い}れ — pen case).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革|かわ}の{財布入|さいふい}れ: leather wallet case
- {財布入|さいふい}れに{入|い}れる: to put in the wallet case
- {首|くび}{掛|か}け{財布入|さいふい}れ: neck wallet/pouch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {財布|さいふ}: wallet — the wallet itself
- {小銭|こぜに}{入|い}れ: coin purse — a small container specifically for coins
- セキュリティポーチ: security pouch — a travel pouch for valuables
